tutorial.title: Using the 3D Scenes Studio
steps: Switch between the Kinetic Orrery, Pavilion of Light, and Aero Turbofan Rig in the bottom dock.
Drag to orbit, scroll to zoom, and click any mechanical or architectural sub-assembly to inspect it.
Slide Explode to separate parts smoothly, and test physical material finishes and lighting moods.
Open Presets to save or restore your camera pose, finish, and lighting setup.
tips: Press H anytime to collapse or expand the control dock for an unobstructed 3D view.

welcome.title: Welcome to CoLab
welcome.desc: Your all-in-one workspace for exploring Google's latest AI models. Let's take a quick tour to get you started.

tools.title: Explore the Tools
tools.desc: Use the sidebar to navigate between different features like Chat, Video Generation, Image Editing, and more.

canvas.title: Infinite Creative Canvas
canvas.desc: Our newest flagship feature! Easily drag-and-drop previously generated images, videos, and chat snippets straight onto an infinite board, customize sticky notes, and connect the dots with real-time room codes.

coins.title: CoCoins Quota system
coins.desc: Every AI task uses CoCoins on our shared-compute network. Track usage directly via your Dashboard, and upgrade or claim free rewards to keep your momentum going.

keys.title: Secure Your API Keys
keys.desc: Some advanced features require a Google Cloud API key. You can set this up securely in the Settings menu (gear icon) under Secrets.

history.title: Never Lose Your Work
history.desc: Your generated content and chat conversations are automatically saved to your History, so you can always pick up where you left off.

tutorial.autofill_prompt: Tell me a short joke about AI, and conclude with a funny self-deprecating comment!

suggest.title: Interactive Tutorial Walkthrough
suggest.desc: In just 30 seconds, experience your first AI interaction, interface control, and our state-of-the-art satisfaction feedback tracker!

step1.title: Step 1: Go to Chat Interface 💬
step1.desc: Click 'Chat' in the sidebar, or click the button below to jump straight in and begin your high-intelligence chat conversation.

step2.title: Step 2: Define your prompt 📝
step2.desc: Type what you'd like Gemini to complete for you. Click the button below to autofill a playful demo query!

step3.title: Step 3: Send and process 🚀
step3.desc: Click the Send button or hit Enter to submit. Gemini will immediately analyze your prompt and begin crafting its response.

step_await.title: Gemini is thinking...
step_await.desc: The powerful Gemini engine is designing the perfect response. Please wait, we will proceed automatically once it's ready!

step4.title: Step 4: Quality Feedback & Printing ⚖️
step4.desc: Under every response, we've designed rating buttons to track satisfaction, along with a custom 'Print' button to easily print or print-to-pdf.

complete.title: Congrats! You're a pro! 🌟
complete.desc: You've successfully mastered the key mechanics of CoLab. We've added +50 free Co-Coins to your account quota!
